README.txt:
Optimized coordinates and Gaussian input files for the two ILs and both gases at the three sampled site initializations.
Source: local il_gas calculation summary.json files. These are gas-phase electronic binding energies relative to isolated optimized monomers, corrected for BSSE, not Gibbs free energies. Site names describe initialization; distinct labels need not remain distinct after optimization.
The isolated optimized ion-pair and gas coordinates are also provided. A calculation with no frequency analysis must not be certified as a vibrational minimum.
Gaussian 16 Rev. A.03; B3LYP-D3(BJ)/6-31G(d,p).
